name: Takaro Official Registry
description: Modules made and reviewed by the Takaro team.

modules.name: afk-kick
modules.description: AFK Kick — periodically checks player positions and warns/kicks idle players. A permission exempts specific players from AFK detection.

modules.name: community-fund
modules.description: Community Fund — players contribute currency toward a shared goal. When the threshold is reached the fund resets and completion commands fire.

modules.name: discord-status-bridge-7d2d
modules.description: 7 Days to Die Discord bridge with chat relay, localized monitoring events, blood moon notices, and a persistent customizable server status message.

modules.name: kill-tracker
modules.description: Kill/Death Tracker — tracks player kills, deaths, and points with streaks, leaderboards, and seasonal resets.

modules.name: mini-games
modules.description: Unified mini-games module with daily puzzles (Wordle, Hangman, Hot/Cold) and live chat rounds (Trivia, Scramble, Math race, Reaction race). Skill-based, point-scoring, optional currency rewards, boost tiers, cross-game leaderboards. Trivia rounds fetch questions from the public Open Trivia Database (https://opentdb.com) when `triviaQuestionSource` is `api` (the default), so the module makes outbound HTTPS requests to opentdb.com from Takaro; on failure it falls back to the custom bank.

modules.name: playtime-buff-rewards
modules.description: Hourly playtime rewards with configurable currency, command, and buff rewards.

modules.name: referral-program
modules.description: Players invite others via a referral code; referrers earn currency or items when their referees hit a playtime threshold, with daily/lifetime caps and VIP tiering.

modules.name: server-toolkit
modules.description: Cross-game utility commands for server info, rules, moderation, and simple economy administration.

modules.name: vote-restart
modules.description: Vote Restart — players vote democratically to restart the server. Dynamic threshold based on online non-immune players.

modules.name: zombie-racing
modules.description: Zombie Racing lets players bet on a configurable virtual race, locks betting when a race starts, broadcasts live race commentary while the race is running, then finishes the race through delayed hooks after the configured duration.
